edges.reason: portMessage onlyBridge check trusts bridgePort, an owner-settable address, to authorize callers.
msg.sender is compared against bridgePort to gate token minting.
Owner can repoint bridgePort, redirecting bridge authorization and outbound calls.
bridgePort supplies the external call target in swapAcrossChain.
swapAcrossChain forwards caller value and data to the external bridge contract.
Any caller can invoke withdrawDividend and becomes the ETH dividend recipient.
withdrawDividend delegates the payout to _withdrawDividendOfUser for msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as the payable user argument of the withdrawal routine.
processAccount invokes _withdrawDividendOfUser for arbitrary tracker accounts.
process loop reaches processAccount, driving ETH withdrawals during iteration.
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs a low-level ETH call to the user address.
The ETH transfer yields control to an arbitrary user contract that can reenter.
withdrawnDividends is read and written around the external call.
On a failed callback the withdrawnDividends entry is rolled back, altering accounting.
canAutoClaim gates automatic dividend claims purely on block.timestamp.
processAccount records lastClaimTimes from block.timestamp.
The process loop queries canAutoClaim for each holder.
setBalance triggers processAccount after syncing a tracker balance.
_transfer invokes burnFees before liquidating contract tokens.
_transfer swaps contract tokens for ETH when an AMM pair transfer occurs.
swapAndSendToDev swaps tokens through swapTokensForEth.
swapAndSendToDev forwards swapped ETH via sendEthToDev.
swapTokensForEth calls the router with zero slippage protection and block.timestamp deadline.
sendEthToDev pushes ETH to owner-set marketing wallets.
burnFees transfers tokens to the owner-set burn address.
uniswapV2Router supplies the swap target and WETH path element.
Pair balance is used to cap the amount liquidated in _transfer.
AMM pair flags determine buy/sell fee branches and swap triggering.
Fee-exemption mapping disables fee charging for chosen accounts.
taxThreshold bracket lookup and index arithmetic select the applied fee.
buyTaxAmount percentage multiplies the transfer amount.
sellTaxAmount percentage multiplies the transfer amount.
totalFees is used as a divisor in liquidation amount computation.
burnFeePercentage scales the contract balance before burning.
burnAddress is the destination of the fee-burn transfer.
liquidating acts as a guard around the swap-and-send block inside transfers.
isInPort suppresses liquidation while a bridge port message is being processed.
updateCode delegates to updateCodeAddress to rewrite the implementation slot.
Owner-supplied newCode address is written as the implementation.
Inline assembly sstore replaces the logic contract address.
initialized guards proxyConstructor against repeated initialization.
proxyConstructor calls initialize() to lock the logic contract.
proxyConstructor configures the Uniswap router address.
proxyConstructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair.
proxyConstructor calls excludeFromFees during initialization.
Internal setter mutates the AMM pair mapping gating fee logic.
setFeeSplitPecentages recomputes totalFees used as a divisor.
setBurnPercentage changes the burn scaling factor.
setBurnAddress changes the token burn destination.
manualSwap delegates to swapAndSendToDev.
activate flips the tradingEnabled gate.
setETHWallets repoints the primary ETH payout address.
setETHWallets repoints the secondary ETH payout address.
setTaxThresholdFees rewrites buy tax percentages.
setTaxThresholdFees rewrites sell tax percentages.
distributeDividends magnifies msg.value by magnitude and divides by totalSupply.
magnifiedDividendPerShare participates in the dividend withdrawal computation.
gasForTransfer is the gas forwarded to the untrusted dividend receiver.
liquidateTokensAtAmount bounds when contract tokens are liquidated.

normalization_plan.reason: endChain is only forwarded by swapAcrossChain to the bridge call.
recipient is a transient argument of swapAcrossChain forwarded to the bridge.
amount parameterizes the burn and bridge outbound amount in swapAcrossChain.
destination is a payload argument of swapAcrossChain only.
preferredNode is a payload argument of swapAcrossChain only.
recipient is the mint target inside portMessage.
amount governs the mint and transfer inside portMessage.
newCode flows directly into updateCodeAddress as the new implementation.
tokens is the only argument of manualSwap.
amount is the ETH amount distributed by sendEthToDev.
tokenAmount is the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
user is the payout target inside _withdrawDividendOfUser.
account identifies the balance owner in setBalance.
newBalance is synchronized by setBalance.
gas bounds the processing loop in process.
account determines whose dividends are withdrawn in processAccount.
automatic only labels the Claim event in processAccount.
from determines fee exemption and AMM branch in _transfer.
to determines AMM pair fee branch and liquidation trigger in _transfer.
amount drives fee bracket selection and subtraction in _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a cached value inside _transfer.
feeIndex indexes the tax arrays inside _transfer.
fees accumulates the computed fee inside _transfer.
canSwap controls the liquidation branch inside _transfer.
takeFee controls whether fees are deducted inside _transfer.
initialBalance snapshots ETH before the swap in swapAndSendToDev.
newBalance is the ETH delta measured in swapAndSendToDev.
_withdrawableDividend is the payout amount in _withdrawDividendOfUser.
success records the low-level call outcome in _withdrawDividendOfUser.
path is the router swap path in swapTokensForEth.
amountToBurn is the burn quantity computed in burnFees.
